translations.web: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of nations, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
translations.bsb: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
translations.kjv: Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
translations.asv: Ascribe unto Jehovah, ye kindreds of the peoples, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.
